main_result.result: Added an explicit DurableAppendWriter acknowledgement boundary plus LaunchCapability. The capability is issued only after exact expected-before + ADMIT full-journal readback, and the capability-gated slot entry point rechecks the acknowledged prefix, ADMIT/reporting/slot-plan/deadline digests and current recovered active block before preparing score-bearing SLOT evidence.
main_result.crash_integrity_stress: Contract-faithful injected-adapter harness rejected all 350 partial acknowledgement byte cuts and all 350 single-byte mutations of the acknowledged durable prefix, plus tampered capability payload, wrong block, wrong slot, stale-after-CLOSE and truncated-after-ack cases. The exact acknowledged frame issued a capability that remained reusable across distinct admitted slots of the same active block.
main_result.remaining_enforcement_boundary: Historical replay modules remain immutable and still expose the old prepare_slot API. The new gate therefore removes caller discipline only for an active launcher wired through prepare_slot_authorized; it does not make a malicious/direct import of the old API impossible.

measurement_validity_rules: Prepared ADMIT bytes are never launch authority. Only exact durable readback acknowledgement can create a launch capability.
A launch capability is bound to one exact durable ADMIT prefix, block identity, slot plan, deadline, reporting admission and adapter semantics; truncation or mutation of that prefix invalidates it.
Capability reuse is allowed only while the exact admitted block remains active; CLOSE or a different active block makes it stale.

The capability hash is integrity binding, not secret authentication. Statistical/crash validity assumes non-adversarial callers and a writer that really implements CAS + append + durability acknowledgement + readback.
Scientific semantics are unchanged: this artifact changes durable operation authorization only, not the K-guard, estimator, alpha allocation, reporting phase or tested scope.

Because exact production sibling files were not locally executable in this environment, the current crash suite validates the gate contract against an injected deterministic adapter; production byte-execution remains required before stronger implementation claims.
frontier: Byte-execute the persisted gate against the exact bound durable adapter and production V3/K-guard sibling files in a repository-local runtime, repeating the full acknowledgement-boundary crash suite without the injected fake adapter.

Implement a concrete DurableAppendWriter over the actual journal storage and inject crashes at append-before-fsync, fsync-before-readback, and readback-before-capability-delivery; uncertain acknowledgement must never issue a capability and exact retry must be idempotent.
Wire the real score-bearing launcher exclusively to prepare_slot_authorized while keeping historical replay modules immutable, so direct prepare_slot is not an active-runtime bypass.
Stress production V3 residual-alpha fresh allocation and CLOSE/report-exposure acknowledgement under the launch-capability path.
Define a non-retroactive migration rule for legacy ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE rows that predate enriched reporting metadata and therefore cannot honestly receive pre-score launch capabilities.
exact_next_action: Implement and validate a concrete single-writer file/storage DurableAppendWriter whose append_fsync_readback performs expected-before CAS, append, fsync, and full readback; crash-inject the three acknowledgement sub-boundaries and prove that only an exact durable acknowledgement yields a usable LaunchCapability, with exact idempotent retry after recovery.
